meta.description: TR-11, Blueprint §10 flow 1. Daily 02:00: rebuild the fact fabric for D-2..D-1 (a 2-day window absorbs late time-entry/activity edits) via POST facts/recompute, which ALSO writes auto_missed check-ins for D-1 and is idempotent (recompute the same window twice -> byte-identical rows, proven by fact-job.db.test.ts) -- safe to re-drive on any retry. `facts/recompute` is deliberately NEVER an MCP tool (Blueprint §9.2: 'recompute (ops)' is explicitly excluded), so this flow calls platform-nest DIRECTLY with the platform's own PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN under the OBO identity wf:reports-nightly-facts (seed:automation grants it company_admin, the minimum role resource_report_admin.yaml's `recompute` action allows for this ops path) -- it makes NO mcp-hub call and needs no hub allow-list entry. On failure: the HTTP node retries x3 (built-in retryOnFail), then the error branch raises an IN-APP notification via the hub's `notify` tool (no ntfy reachable from n8n's own docker network in this deployment -- see automation/README.md's note on why this substitutes for a direct ntfy post). Env: PLATFORM_URL, PLATFORM_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, NOTIFY_USER_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, recipientId: $env.NOTIFY_USER_ID, type: "reports_nightly_facts_failed", payload: { from: $json.from, to: $json.to, error: $json.error } } } }) }}
